scripts.deploy: node scripts/configure.mjs --require && react-router build && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/configure.mjs && wrangler types --strict-vars=false && react-router typegen && tsc -b
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/configure.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/configure.mjs --require && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
